title: AntiCurse
description: Stops players from using your modpack on the CurseForge Launcher.
body:
![banner](https://i.imgur.com/DccuAG1.png)

### Purpose
The purpose for this mod is to prevent players from launching modpacks with the CurseForge Launcher. This could be for personal/licensing reasons or to avoid involvement with the [Middle East conflict](https://mcmods.mitl.it/anticurse/about).

### Features:

- Prevents players from loading up a game with the CurseForge Launcher whilst the mod is installed.
- No config required.

**REQUIRES [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)**
